name: writing_plans
description: Writing plans: creates step-by-step implementation plans for features, tasks, or projects. Breaks a goal into ordered steps with statuses (pending/doing/done/failed), notes on why the plan changed, and dependencies. Pure-Python, no external dependencies, runs on any surface.

operation.description: One of: create | list | update | sources. Defaults to sources.

goal.description: The goal or feature to plan.

note.description: Why the plan changed, if it did.

limit.description: Maximum plans to return. Defaults to 10.

author: Stella
notes: Pure-Python skill. Plans are held in memory for the session; nothing is written to disk unless paired with write_note or document_ops.
